Carmignac Gestion increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 0.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Carmignac Gestion bought 31,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 5.45M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $961.37M, up from 5.42M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carmignac Gestion who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 9.79M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Carmignac Gestion, which manages about $15.05B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Methanex Corp (NASDAQ:MEOH) by 65,000 shares to 350,000 shares, valued at $21.19M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cemex Sab (NYSE:CX) by 34.12M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 26.65M shares, and cut its stake in Noble Energy Inc (Prn) (Call) (NYSE:NBL).
